name: Vaucluse

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.

blurb.text: A departmental IGP where Grenache covers. Every wine is approved at a tasting, and the name can add Aigues or Principauté d'Orange.
